title: Garder la maison ensemble  (Holding the Fort Together)

segments.t: Back at the Paris office, Hervé returns flustered, only to find Noémie crying after giving up her travel ticket to Mathias's wife. Recognizing her heartbreak over Mathias, Hervé offers comforting words and decides to stay in Paris with her so they can hold down the fort together. Listen to the scene in French first.
C'est horrible, vraiment horrible!
Tu n'es pas dans le train?
Non, je n'y vais plus.
Mais pourquoi ce changement soudain?
Le moment était vraiment mal choisi.
Tu peux y aller si tu veux.
Je garderai la maison tout seul.
Tu es sûre de ton choix?
Tu as prévenu Mathias?
J'ai dit que j'étais malade.
Tu pleures, Noémie?
C'est à cause d'un homme?
Oui, mais je vais m'en remettre.
Je vais rester ici aussi.
Merci pour ton soutien, Hervé!
Let's walk through the conversation step by step.
C'est horrible, vraiment horrible!
'It is horrible, truly horrible!' Herve vents about a bizarre dog incident outside.
Tu n'es pas dans le train?
'Are you not on the train?' Herve is surprised to find Noemie still at the office.
Non, je n'y vais plus.
'No, I am not going anymore.' Noemie reveals that she cancelled her trip to Cannes.
Mais pourquoi ce changement soudain?
'But why this sudden change?' Herve inquires about her sudden reversal.
Le moment était vraiment mal choisi.
'The timing was really poorly chosen.' She makes an excuse about poor timing.
Tu peux y aller si tu veux.
'You can go if you want.' Noemie offers her colleague the opportunity to attend the festival instead.
Je garderai la maison tout seul.
'I will hold down the fort all alone.' She volunteers to manage the agency office in Paris.
Tu es sûre de ton choix?
'Are you sure of your choice?' Herve checks if she truly wants to stay behind.
Tu as prévenu Mathias?
'Have you warned Mathias?' He asks whether her boss and lover knows she cancelled.
J'ai dit que j'étais malade.
'I said that I was sick.' Noemie admits to telling a white lie to cover up her heartache.
Tu pleures, Noémie?
'Are you crying, Noémie?' Herve notices tears welling up in her eyes.
C'est à cause d'un homme?
'Is it because of a man?' He intuitively suspects romantic heartbreak behind her tears.
Oui, mais je vais m'en remettre.
'Yes, but I will get over it.' Noemie acknowledges the pain while trying to stay brave.
Je vais rester ici aussi.
'I will stay here too.' Touched by her distress, Herve decides to keep her company in Paris.
Merci pour ton soutien, Hervé!
'Thank you for your support, Hervé!' She appreciates his comforting presence during a difficult moment. Now listen to the whole scene again at normal speed, and see how much more you catch.

J'ai dit que j'étais malade.
Tu pleures, Noémie?
C'est à cause d'un homme?
Oui, mais je vais m'en remettre.
Je vais rester ici aussi.
Merci pour ton soutien, Hervé!
Comforting a tearful Noémie over her secret heartbreak, Hervé decides to stay behind in Paris so they can look after the office together. See you next time!
Bonne journée!
